This project will focus on: (i) developing advanced, novel regeneration processes to reduce thermal energy requirements and lower desorption temperature; and (ii) designing the air contactor to reduce pressure drop and optimize CO₂ absorption. The first goal aims to reduce the thermal energy needed for overcoming the reaction enthalpy of H O and simultaneously enable a higher cyclic CO₂ capacity; the 2 2 second goal aims to maximize the CO₂ capture volumetric productivity to reduce land requirements and environmental footprint for Holocene’s “earth-changing” DAC system.
